userStories.title: Phase 1 activation sequence (days 0-6)
userStories.description: As a new trialist, I want a helpful onboarding/activation sequence in my first days so I experience the product's value fast, increasing the odds I convert. Implements the in-trial activation steps of the trial_conversion campaign.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed steps on the trial_conversion campaign: Day 0 welcome + 'grade your first item' (trigger signup); Day 1 first-grade nudge (trigger T+1d AND NOT first_grade, skipped if first_grade occurred); Day 2 'how grading lifts resale price' value email (trigger first_grade event); Day 3 'accurate listing management' education; Day 5 social-proof + feature highlight.

Each step's copy is generated/rendered via the US-918 copywriter + US-919 renderer from a per-step brief (goal, key points, CTA) stored on the step, grounded only in real platform capabilities (no invented claims).
Branch: an inactivity nudge fires if the user has no activity for 3 days during the trial (last_active_at), inserted without breaking the main timeline.
CTAs deep-link into the exact next action (grade an item, create a listing) with tracking.
Copy is personalized where useful (name, items graded so far) with safe fallbacks.
Steps respect the frequency cap and exit-on-conversion universally.

userStories.title: Phase 2 conversion-push sequence (days 7-14)
userStories.description: As a trialist approaching the end of my trial, I want a personalized recap and clear, urgent reasons to subscribe before I lose Pro, so I convert rather than lapse. Implements the conversion-push steps tied to trial_ends_at.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed steps: Day 7 mid-trial personalized recap + ROI framing (their activity to date); Day 10 deep-dive on a high-value feature they haven't used (branch: skip if used); Day 12 'trial ends in 2 days' urgency (trigger trial_ends_at - 2d); Day 13 'ends tomorrow / what you'll lose' (trigger trial_ends_at - 1d); Day 14 'last chance today' (trigger trial_ends_at).
Urgency steps are anchored to the actual trial_ends_at (not a fixed offset) so an admin-adjusted trial window (admin-billing.ts) stays correct.
The recap pulls real per-user numbers (grades, listings, sales, certificates) via the personalization layer; a zero-activity trialist gets a re-activation variant instead.
Each email's primary CTA is 'add a card / subscribe' deep-linked to the Stripe checkout for their recommended plan.
Steps clearly state what Pro features are lost on downgrade (grounded in plan-gate.ts entitlements).
Convert-at-any-point exits the sequence and stops further urgency emails.

userStories.title: Phase 3 post-trial win-back sequence (days 15-28)
userStories.description: As a lapsed trialist now on Free, I want a respectful win-back sequence that reminds me what I'm missing and makes upgrading easy, so I can still convert after the trial. Implements the post-trial win-back steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed steps for users whose trial expired to Free (trial_expired event / subscription_status none): Day 16 'you're on Free now - here's what you're missing'; Day 20 value/objection-handling email; Day 24 incentive offer (see US-945, config-gated); Day 28 final win-back, then exit to the general weekly newsletter.
Entry is conditioned on NOT converted and NOT suppressed/opted-out; users who converted during the trial never enter win-back.
Frequency/quiet-hours/consent all enforced; win-back is unambiguously marketing and fully honors unsubscribe.
On exit (day 28 or conversion), the user is handed back to the standard newsletter cadence (newsletter un-paused).
Copy emphasizes outcomes and the specific Pro features they used during trial (from user_events) for relevance.
A test asserts a converted user is excluded and an opted-out user receives none.

userStories.title: Conversion incentive / promo integration
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want an optional, config-gated discount in the win-back (e.g. limited-time % off the first month) wired to the existing coupons system and tracked, so I can lift conversions without hardcoding or leaking discounts. Off by default.
acceptanceCriteria: A per-campaign 'incentive' setting (off by default) references an existing Stripe-backed coupon/promo (reuse the admin coupons system) and an expiry window; when on, the Day-24 win-back email surfaces a unique, time-boxed upgrade offer.
Promo codes are generated/assigned per recipient (or a shared time-boxed code) with redemption tracked back to the drip step for ROI; never expose a code to a user not in the win-back.
Checkout CTA pre-applies the promo so conversion is one click; redemption attributes to the incentive in analytics.
Guardrails: incentive respects a max-discount and an eligibility check (e.g. only post-trial, never to already-paid), enforced server-side.
Turning the incentive off cleanly reverts the Day-24 email to the value-only variant.
Admin can configure/enable the incentive from the drip builder; changes audited + step-up.

userStories.title: Autonomous orchestration tick (trigger cron)
userStories.description: As the operator, I want one scheduled trigger (Make.com/cron) that runs the whole drip engine autonomously - enroll new trialists, evaluate triggers, advance steps, send due emails, exit on goal - with zero per-message human input.
acceptanceCriteria: New POST /api/drip/tick (auth mirrors content-scheduler.ts: X-Internal-Job-Secret OR admin JWT, constant-time) that: enrolls users matching entry triggers, evaluates active enrollments, and dispatches due steps via the bounded resumable batch.
Job-locked (no overlapping runs), idempotent, and frequent-safe (self-gates on next_evaluation_at) so the Make schedule can be simple (e.g. hourly).
Each run records to the jobs console (US-881) with counts: enrolled, advanced, sent, exited, skipped.
Time-anchor triggers (trial_ends_at - 2d) are honored within the tick granularity; a missed window (downtime) is caught up on the next run, not skipped.
Secrets via env (DRIP_INTERNAL_JOB_SECRET); no hardcoding.
A dry-run mode logs what WOULD send without sending, for safe verification.

userStories.title: Per-step A/B testing + conversion self-tuning
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want drip steps to A/B test subject/content/send-timing and automatically favor what drives conversions (not just opens), so the sequence improves itself over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Each step supports variants (subject/body/CTA/send-offset); the engine assigns variants per enrollment and records variant + outcome (open/click/convert) on the send ledger.
Winner selection optimizes for the goal (conversion, with click as a secondary signal), requires a minimum sample, and falls back to a default below threshold (no spurious winners on small cohorts).
Self-tuning reuses the US-928 closed-loop machinery: step timing/subject style weights shift toward higher-converting variants with an exploration floor.
All tuning is autonomous and data-driven, but visible and overridable in the builder.
Tests: across simulated cohorts, the higher-converting variant becomes the default and a high-unsub variant is retired.
Attribution (US-944) feeds the optimizer.

userStories.title: Visual drip / journey builder (admin)
userStories.description: As an operator, I want to see and edit the drip as a visual sequence - steps, triggers, delays, branches, per-step content and variants - plus preview/test-send and a pause/kill switch, so I have full oversight of an autonomous system.
acceptanceCriteria: New admin page src/pages/admin/drip.tsx renders each campaign as an ordered/branching step list (trigger, delay/anchor, conditions, branch targets, exit) with inline editing of per-step brief/copy and variants.

Actions: preview a step's rendered HTML, send a test to an admin address, edit/regenerate copy (via US-918), toggle the incentive, and pause/resume or kill the whole campaign (kill integrates with feature-flags); destructive changes audited + step-up.
A live view of current enrollments by step + recent exits (converted/lapsed) with drill-in to a single user's journey + send history.
Editing validates the step graph (no loops/orphans) before save.
Shows the next scheduled tick and a 'simulate for this user' that runs the dry-run evaluator against a chosen account.
Gated by /api/admin/* (admin JWT + AAL2).

userStories.title: Trial-conversion analytics dashboard
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a funnel and ROI dashboard for the trial drip - step-by-step progression, conversion rate, time-to-convert, drop-off, revenue attributed, and cohort-by-signup-week - so I can prove and improve the sequence.
acceptanceCriteria: New RPC drip_analytics(campaign, period) computes the per-step funnel (sent -> opened -> clicked -> converted), overall trial->paid conversion rate, median days-to-convert, drop-off per step, and attributed MRR, from the enrollment/send/attribution tables.
GET /api/admin/drip/analytics returns the rollup with period + cohort (signup-week) filtering; a page/tab charts the funnel and cohort retention/conversion curves.
Compare in-trial vs post-trial-win-back conversion contribution, and incentive-on vs incentive-off lift.
Flags steps with high unsub/drop-off for attention and surfaces the A/B winners.
Read-only, server-side aggregated; reconciles conversions with Stripe (source of truth) within a documented tolerance.
Numbers tie back to the attribution ledger (US-944) with documented definitions.

userStories.title: In-browser camera capture for web grading submission
userStories.description: As a seller grading on mobile web, I want to shoot photos directly inside the submission flow instead of leaving for the phone camera, so grading is one continuous action. Today src/components/submission/photo-upload.tsx is file-input only, so each of the 4 required slots forces a leave-app/find-file/return round-trip on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: Each photo slot offers a 'Take photo' option (getUserMedia/WebRTC) on camera-capable devices, alongside the existing file picker.
Captured frames run the SAME client compression + EXIF extraction and server validateImageUpload() path as uploads (no bypass).
Permission denied or unsupported browser falls back gracefully to the file input with a clear message (no dead-end).
Live capture works for required and optional/defect slots; orientation is correct on iOS Safari.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / Grade] Added 2026-06-12. Reuses photo-upload.tsx slot model + image-utils compression + lib/upload-validation.ts (US-276). Mirrors the iOS native CameraSession experience for web. Pairs with US-948.

userStories.title: Per-slot photo guidance + completeness progress in submission flow
userStories.description: As a first-time grader, I want shoot hints and a clear 'N of 4' progress indicator so I take gradeable photos the first time and don't land in the low-confidence retake loop. new-submission.tsx only disables Continue until all 4 are present (binary, no guidance), and photo-upload.tsx slots are unlabeled beyond Front/Back/Label/Detail.
acceptanceCriteria: Each required slot shows a one-line shoot hint (e.g. 'Lay flat, full garment, neutral background'; 'Tag must be legible') and an example thumbnail.
Step header shows 'N of 4 required photos' and highlights which required slot is still missing.
When all 4 required photos are present and validated, the flow auto-advances to Review with a brief undo affordance.
Hints render correctly on mobile 2-col grid without shrinking tap targets.
Typecheck passes

Files: src/pages/new-submission.tsx (step/Continue logic ~lines 228-235, 524-531), src/components/submission/photo-upload.tsx. Pairs with US-947, US-949.

userStories.title: One-tap retake on low-confidence and expired submissions
userStories.description: As a seller whose grade came back needs_photos (or whose payment expired), I want to retake just the flagged photos without re-entering everything, so a low-confidence result isn't a dead end. Today submission-detail.tsx shows the needs_photos feedback (~lines 1056-1081) and expired state (~1082-1094) with NO retry path — the user must create a brand-new submission and the old one is orphaned.
acceptanceCriteria: needs_photos and expired states show a 'Retake photos' CTA.
Retake prefills garment_type, category, title, brand from the prior submission and preserves any inventory item linkage.
The specific photo_requests the grader flagged are highlighted; passing photos can be reused.
The new submission references the prior one; the old submission is marked superseded (not orphaned) and excluded from active counts.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / Grade] Added 2026-06-12. Files: src/pages/submission-detail.tsx (needs_photos/expired branches), src/pages/new-submission.tsx (prefill). Server: tenant-scope the supersede update (US-268). May need a superseded_by column on submissions — check before adding; reuse existing status enum if a needs_photos/superseded value already exists.

userStories.title: Show grade pricing and billing method before photo upload
userStories.description: As a seller deciding whether to grade, I want to see tier cost and which billing method applies (included grade / credits / checkout) from step 1, so I'm not surprised by a payment wall after uploading photos. Today tier pricing and the payment-precedence summary only appear in the step-3 review (new-submission.tsx ~lines 638-706).
acceptanceCriteria: A persistent cost summary on step 1 shows each tier's credit cost and the billing method that will apply, using the existing payment-precedence logic.
The summary updates live as the user changes tier.
If checkout will be required (no included grades, no credits), that is stated upfront, not mid-flow.
No change to the actual charge logic — display only.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Local draft autosave and resume for web grading submission
userStories.description: As a seller filling the grading wizard, I want my progress saved locally so a refresh or network blip doesn't lose my garment info and uploaded photos. The flow is fully online today with no draft/resume.

Returning to new-submission detects a draft and offers 'Resume draft' or 'Start over'.
Draft is cleared on successful submit and on explicit discard.
No PII beyond what the form already holds; never persists image binaries.
Typecheck passes

The completion notification reports published vs skipped counts with reasons.

userStories.title: Clear the estimated-price flag when AI price confidence is high
userStories.description: As a reseller, I want confidently-priced drafts to NOT show an 'est.' badge, so I only review prices the AI is unsure about. Today price_is_estimated is set true for every generated price regardless of ai_field_confidence.listing_price, so even 0.95-confidence prices are flagged.
acceptanceCriteria: When ai_field_confidence.listing_price >= a configurable threshold (default 0.85), price_is_estimated is cleared and the 'est.' badge is hidden in drafts and bulk-edit.
Below threshold, behavior is unchanged.
The threshold lives in one place (constant/config), not scattered.
Manual price edits always clear the estimated flag as today.
Typecheck passes

Small, high-signal cleanup.

userStories.title: Inline photo QA feedback during AutoLister intake
userStories.description: As a reseller, I want a quick photo-quality signal during upload/grouping, before I spend AI generation quota, so I can reshoot bad photos early. Today photo QA (US-537) runs only after generation, in autolister-queue.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: After upload and grouping, a fast vision pass scores each item's cover photo.
Items whose cover scores below ~60 show a non-blocking 'reshoot recommended' nudge before the Generate button.
The nudge never blocks generation (advisory only) and reuses the existing photo-QA endpoint.
QA runs with bounded concurrency and does not noticeably stall the intake UI.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / List] Added 2026-06-12. Files: src/pages/flipdesk/autolister.tsx (intake/grouping), reuse the runPhotoQa endpoint from autolister-queue.tsx (US-537). Saves AI quota by catching unusable photos pre-generation.

userStories.title: Unify listings, grid, and pipeline into one surface with shared state
userStories.description: As a reseller managing inventory, I want one listings surface with Table/Spreadsheet/Kanban view modes that share filters, search, sort, and selection, so switching views doesn't reset my context. Today listings.tsx, grid.tsx, and pipeline.tsx are separate routes with isolated state.
acceptanceCriteria: A single route hosts Triage(table)/Spreadsheet(grid)/Kanban(pipeline) as toggleable view modes.
Filters, search, sort, and current selection persist across view switches via URL params.
Tab/status counts are shared, not recomputed per view.
Switching views does not trigger a full data refetch storm (reuse cached query data).
Old routes redirect to the unified surface with equivalent params.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / Manage] Added 2026-06-12. Files: src/pages/flipdesk/{listings,grid,pipeline}.tsx. Builds on inventory consolidation (US-740) and sidebar IA (US-743). Pairs with virtualization (US-733). Largest of the manage stories — may warrant splitting during planning.

userStories.title: Inline status change and expanded inline edits in listings table
userStories.description: As a reseller, I want to change an item's status and edit cost/target/notes directly from the listings table on any tab, so I don't have to open a detail modal or jump to the spreadsheet for routine edits. Today only price is inline-editable, and only on the Active tab (listings.tsx ~1587-1627); status changes require the detail modal or a pipeline drag.
acceptanceCriteria: Each row has a status control that advances item_status inline without opening the detail modal.
Cost, target, and notes are inline-editable on all relevant tabs using the existing InlineCell pattern.
Edits are optimistic with rollback + toast on server error.
All writes are tenant-scoped (US-268) and respect eBay sync for price where an offer exists.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / Manage] Added 2026-06-12. Files: src/pages/flipdesk/listings.tsx (InlineCell ~1587-1627, rows ~1524-1659), src/components/.../inline-cell.tsx. Mirror the price->eBay-offer fallback logic for status where applicable.

userStories.title: Shipped-tab fulfillment: carrier, tracking, and delivered status
userStories.description: As a reseller, I want to record carrier and tracking and mark items delivered from the Shipped tab, so I can fulfill orders inside FlipDesk. Today the Shipped status carries no carrier/tracking/delivery fields at all (listings.tsx ~209-214).
acceptanceCriteria: Migration 00169 adds carrier, tracking_number, shipped_at, delivered_at to the sales/shipments model and exposes them on the items_full view.
Shipped tab shows tracking entry and a one-click 'Mark delivered'.
A bulk 'Prepare shipment' fills carrier + tracking across selected sold items and advances them to shipped.
RLS/tenant-scoping (US-268) verified on the new columns; cross-tenant regression test updated.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / Manage] Added 2026-06-12. NEW MIGRATION 00169_* (re-check max before creating; 00168 is current). Files: src/pages/flipdesk/listings.tsx (Sold/Shipped tabs, mark-shipped bulk ~867-897). Surface on items_full (security_invoker view, see 00111/00168 pattern).

userStories.title: Mobile bulk actions and quick-edit for listings management
userStories.description: As a reseller on mobile, I want selection, bulk actions, filters, and quick-edit on the listings card view, so I'm not forced to a desktop. Today the mobile fallback (listings.tsx ~1519-1522, ItemCardList) has no checkboxes, no action bar, no filters, and no inline edit.
acceptanceCriteria: Cards show selection checkboxes and a sticky bottom action bar mirroring the desktop bulk actions for the active tab.
A per-card quick-edit drawer edits title, price, status, and notes.
Filter and search are reachable on mobile (sheet/drawer).
Selection and filter state interoperate with the unified surface (US-958).
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / Manage] Added 2026-06-12. Files: src/pages/flipdesk/listings.tsx (md:hidden card path), ItemCardList component. Depends on US-958/US-959 for shared state + inline-edit primitives.

userStories.title: Bulk match-to-comp repricing across selected listings
userStories.description: As a reseller, I want to select multiple active listings and reprice them to their condition-matched comp in one action with a preview, so repricing isn't a one-at-a-time chore on a separate page. Today repricing.tsx applies suggestions individually, and the only bulk price action in listings is a flat 'drop X%'.
acceptanceCriteria: From a listings selection, 'Reprice to comp' computes a per-item suggested price reusing the repricing engine.
A dry-run preview shows current -> suggested deltas and any items skipped (no comps / below margin floor) before applying.
Apply updates the eBay offer (where present) and the local price, respecting the margin floor.
All reads/writes are tenant-scoped (US-268).
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / Manage] Added 2026-06-12. Files: src/pages/flipdesk/repricing.tsx (suggestion engine), src/pages/flipdesk/listings.tsx (bulk actions ~987-1044, bulkPriceDrop). Reuse sold-comp pricing (US-460/542/594). Keep the apply path inside the existing eBay-offer-or-local fallback.

userStories.title: Merge reconcile and reconciliation into one guided flow
userStories.description: As a reseller, I want a single Reconcile area with clear tabs instead of two confusingly-named pages, so I know where to match payouts vs link photos. Today reconcile.tsx (photos->items) and reconciliation.tsx (eBay SKU match + payouts/fees) are separate routes with overlapping names.
acceptanceCriteria: One /dashboard/flipdesk/reconcile route hosts 'Photos -> Items', 'eBay SKU match', and 'Payouts & fees' as tabs sharing layout and navigation.
The two old routes redirect to the appropriate tab; the sidebar shows a single Reconcile entry.
No functional regression: photo clustering/commit and payout matching/sync-history both work as before.
Session-restore behavior of each flow is preserved.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / Manage] Added 2026-06-12. Files: src/pages/flipdesk/reconcile.tsx + reconciliation.tsx, sidebar (src/components/dashboard/sidebar.tsx), routes/index.tsx. Pure consolidation/IA; preserve US-280-287 + US-148/157 behavior.

userStories.title: iOS bulk-publish from AutoLister drafts
userStories.description: As an iOS reseller, I want to multi-select AutoLister drafts and publish them in one action, so I finish the batch on my phone instead of opening each draft. Today drafts can be bulk-edited (US-820) but publishing is one-at-a-time via PublishDialog.
acceptanceCriteria: DraftsLibraryView supports multi-select and a 'Publish N' action.
Each selected draft is validated; ready ones publish via EbayPublishService, blocked ones are skipped with a per-item reason.
A summary reports published vs skipped, reusing the publish result UI.
Local cache (LocalListing) updates optimistically and reconciles on sync.
iOS CI (Swift build + tests) passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / iOS] Added 2026-06-12. Files: ios/GradeThread/Marketplaces/.../DraftsLibraryView + DraftsBulkEditView, EbayPublishService, PublishDialog. Server publish endpoint already tenant-scopes (US-268). userStories.title: iOS searchable eBay category picker and capture photo guidance
userStories.description: As an iOS reseller, I want to search the eBay category tree and get per-slot capture hints, so picking deep clothing subcategories and shooting gradeable photos isn't tedious on a small screen. Today the category picker is a search-less tree browser and capture has no slot guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: The category picker gains a text search over the taxonomy with leaf-node results.
Camera capture shows a per-slot guidance overlay (front/back/tag/detail) matching the web guidance (US-948).
Search and guidance respect VoiceOver/accessibility already established in the app.
iOS CI (Swift build + tests) passes
userStories.notes: [EPIC: Frictionless Three-Flow UX 2026-06-12 / iOS] Added 2026-06-12. Files: ios/GradeThread/Marketplaces/.../EbayCategorySpecificsView + EbayAspectsService, ios/GradeThread/Capture/CameraSession. Parity with web US-948.

userStories.title: iOS negotiation inbox: send offer responses
userStories.description: As an iOS reseller, I want to accept, decline, or counter best offers from the negotiation inbox, so I don't have to leave for the eBay app or web. Today the inbox (US-673) is read-only on iOS.

Actions call the edge eBay offer endpoints and update optimistically with sync reconciliation.
Errors (expired offer, eBay rejection) are surfaced clearly and the item state stays consistent.
Server offer endpoints are tenant-scoped (US-268).
